claim: Multi-Region strong consistency (MRSC) for global tables is generally available since June 30, 2025, with an optional witness Region and a Recovery Point Objective (RPO) of zero. MRSC was first announced as a preview at AWS re:Invent 2024, and the document history lists it on December 3, 2024. Before MRSC, global tables were eventually consistent.

qualifiers.condition: exactly three Regions; three replicas or two replicas and one witness
